article.title: Recall of witnesses when charge altered
article.html:
240Recall of witnesses when charge altered

Section 240 · Chapter XVIII · Form of charges

Whenever a charge is altered or added to by the Court after the commencement of the trial, the prosecutor and the accused shall be allowed—

(a)to recall or re-summon, and examine with reference to such alteration or addition, any witness who may have been examined, unless the Court, for reasons to be recorded in writing, considers that the prosecutor or the accused, as the case may be, desires to recall or re-examine such witness for the purpose of vexation or delay or for defeating the ends of justice;

(b)also to call any further witness whom the Court may think to be material.
